text: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him: Or, thus did Samuel, before he knew the LORD; and before the word of the LORD was revealed unto him
when I begin, I will also make an end: Heb. beginning and ending
for I have told him: Or, and I will tell him, etc. | vile: Or, accurse | restrained them not: Heb. frowned not upon them
more also: so add | thing: Or, word
every whit: Heb. all the things, or words
